quest.title: Those Who Yearn for the Gods' Gaze
quest.description: You take up the post of leader of Swordfish II. Unexpectedly, Teppei has also received a promotion...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Mora x22000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go and investigate the ancient ruins

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be the place. But Sangonomiya was right, it doesn't look like anything suspicious is going on...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Could they be hiding? {NICKNAME}, let's see what we can find.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These <color=#00E1FFFF>Electro Monuments</color> look a little suspicious...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... glad that's over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As monsters go, that one was pretty tough. But what's such a huge Thunderhelm Lawachurl doing here in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It doesn't make any sense... Also, the atmosphere here gives Paimon the creeps.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, the good thing is that it's over now. We should probably get going... Huh, Teppei? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: *cough* ...Wow, this is a surprise. Didn't know you were the ones investigating here.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I just got back from delivering some supplies to the front line. I figured I'd stop by and clear any threats in this area on the way back. *cough*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you alright there buddy? You're looking slightly the worse for wear.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I'm fine, it's nothing. I must've caught a cold a couple days ago while I was out at sea.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: On my way past, I heard that someone had just arrived on the island to investigate, so I thought I'd come and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: If there'd been some real danger, I might've had the chance to be the hero... Heh, shame it was just you guys. Guess I came here for nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Teppei, don't you think there's something strange about this place?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Hmm... now that you mention it, there is something a little off about it.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: It could be that the Tatarigami is more palpable here, I guess. We're not that far away from Orobaxi's remains.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Orobaxi? Who's that?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: A god. Look, there's the corpse over there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aah! It's a gigantic snake skeleton. It looks terrifying!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Orobaxi was the one who brought our ancestors from Enkanomiya up to the surface. That's the origin of the Watatsumi Island you know today.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Our ancestors regarded it as a guardian deity, but during the Archon War, Orobaxi invaded Yashiori Island.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: The Raiden Shogun came out in person and slew Orobaxi with the Musou no Hitotachi. That same slash also formed what later became known as Musoujin Gorge.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Raiden Shogun created Musoujin Gorge in one slash? Wow, that's pretty incredible...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Yes. But the Archon War was brutal... *cough* and Yashiori Island was completely destroyed during that battle. They say the shogun lost something very dear to her along the way too.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Since Orobaxi's death... *cough* there has always been some animosity between Watatsumi Island and the Shogunate. But our different beliefs have nothing to do with why the resistance was formed. We only rose up to fight against the Vision Hunt Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: When Orobaxi attacked civilization, the shogun stood up and put a stop to it.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: But now that the shogun is stripping people of their ambitions with the Vision Hunt Decree, it's time for someone to stand up and stop the shogun... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Alright, I'm heading back. I was just dealing with some of the Shogun's elite samurai, so I think I'm gonna take a quick breather, then it's onto my next assignment.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: You should report back to Sangonomiya as soon as possible. Don't stay here longer than you need to — being around the Tatarigami too long won't do your health any good...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: *coughing*...

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Hey, don't worry about me. Peak condition...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Teppei's sure made some big progress if he's already dealing with Shogunate Samurai. Paimon can hardly believe it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Let's report back to <color=#00E1FFFF>Kokomi</color>, {NICKNAME}.

talks.objective: Return to headquarters and talk to Sangonomiya Kokomi

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kokomi, we're back— Oh, look, Gorou's here too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happened? They look so serious...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Approximately how many people are exhibiting these symptoms?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I haven't had the chance to do a full count yet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kokomi, Gorou... what's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #Recently, {NICKNAME}, some of our soldiers started showing symptoms of accelerated aging.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I called them in for questioning and found out that they'd privately acquired some secret weapons from our sponsor.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Most of them are highly ambitious types, vehemently opposed to the Vision Hunt Decree. They've been using these new weapons secretly since getting hold of them.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: So that's why the war has been going unusually well... But risky secret weapons are not the answer. We must put a stop to it immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Gorou, have you managed to acquire one of these weapons?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Most of the officers refused to hand them over. Still, I did manage to get one...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh dear...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you know something about this?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a Fatui Delusion.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: So that means our secret sponsor is the Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: But why would the Fatui do this...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Forget that, there's no time. Right now, we need to inform the whole army to cease using their Delusions immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: All soldiers who have shown symptoms are to be taken for treatment. I just hope we'll be in time to save them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wait a second... {NICKNAME}, speaking of soldiers with symptoms...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Teppei...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, s—surely he can't have...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, let's go check on him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Teppei!!!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Oh... *cough* Hey, guys. What're you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Just a moment, lemme get up... Oof, it's weird, I don't know where all my strength's gone...

choices.text: Teppei, you have to tell me.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Oh right, yeah, I haven't had time to give you the full details. Well, I've made a lot of great contributions to the war effort lately.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Fighting the Shogun's Army at sea, taking on Shogunate Samurai all by myself, rescuing my comrades fr—from an ambush... things I never would have dreamed I could do when you first met me.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: *cough* If only I were stronger still. The stronger I am, the more I can do for the resistance... Wait a sec, where's my secret weapon gone?

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: *cough* It wasn't long after you were made captain of Swordfish II. I met these mysterious people, said they were with our supporters.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: They gave it to me and said that as long as I have the will to become stronger, this secret weapon will answer my call.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Haha... *cough* It's just like a Vision, isn't it? Of course, I've never used a Vision, so I wouldn't know the difference...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is... a Delusion.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Delusion? *cough* Oh god, that doesn't sound very good...

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: So... what's the difference between a Delusion and a Vision?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A Delusion drains the user's life force.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: *cough*

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Gosh... Well, I suppose it's not too surprising that a mysterious weapon of unknown origins would come with its risks.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: I've been getting more and more tired over the past few days, and I have this... strange sense of dread.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: At first I'd find I was a little more beat than usual after a battle. Didn't think anything of it. But today, I got back and suddenly my vision was going blurry.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: This is a real shame... There I was, thinking I was catching up with ya, haha...

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Guess I didn't receive the favor of the gods, after all...

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, would you do something for me?

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: When our uniforms are ready, grab mine for me... bring it back here, and we can change together...

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: What's that look for? Don't worry, partner. Soon as I've rested up, I'll be right as rain. Right as rain, I tell ya... soon as I've... rested up...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Teppei...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Fatui...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, where are you going? Heyyyy...

choices.text: When did you start using it?
What's been going on with you?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Gorou, let's go to the resistance camp ourselves. The use of Delusions has to stop right away.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Yes, Your Excellency!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It was a great pleasure to enjoy a delicious meal to the gentle whisper of the sea breeze. Thank you for making dinner for everyone, Xinyan.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: No problem. I'm just glad y'all enjoyed it. I was real worried that I hadn't made enough for everyone... or that I'd made too much.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: By the way, how was your walk today? Find any high-up spots with a good view?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. The bard's description of an "emerald isle" describes this place perfectly.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh? So what about the rest of the story, is that true as well?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's hard to say. But I do believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Well then, let's hope we wake up tomorrow morning to the sight of the Dodo-King or a Dodoco! That'd be fun.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: ...Of course, I don't mind if that doesn't happen. It's amazing just to be here on the island from the story, and to get to make some friends from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: The mortal temptations stopped the truth in its tracks, denying the verdict of my victory the chance to be announced in my presence.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Wow, I'm surprised you have the nerve to bring that up again.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #You and Oz are like two peas in a pod, trying desperately to convince {NICKNAME} and Paimon that you were the victor. I hardly see how that's fair.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Besides, only the loser would want to get—

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Say that again?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein, she means to say that you are the loser.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Silence, Oz!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Ahem... Lady Megistus, let us put aside the sacred matter of our trial for now. Once I have reclaimed my throne in the Immernachtreich, we shall settle this for good in the Garten Sanssouci!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, that's fine by me, I'll beat you no matter how many times you ask for a rematch... wait, but what is that place, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Achoo!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ugh... Guess I shouldn't get too close to the cats after all... I'll just stay on the roof.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm... I wonder what's really going on with my scryglass...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Leave all further observations to the expert! I'll inform you if anything comes up. Mm-hmm, nice working with you.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Kazuha seems pretty chill, and Her Highness has Mona to watch out for her, so we don't need to worry too much.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: #As for you, {NICKNAME}... you're rockin' it as always, just like I am!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: "I wander like the autumn leaves that float to the mountains and seas afar."

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Though I am still on my journey, my perspective has changed greatly since I first wrote that poem.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The life of a wanderer is full of hardships. I have asked myself these questions many times:

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Should I go? If so, where to, and by what means?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But I have no choice. The boundless world is calling out to me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Farewell, my dear grandfather and father.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: A final farewell, for I do not believe I will ever return to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But if one day, I do return...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...No. That day will never come.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: What kind of mirage would Fischl not want to confront?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Could it be... that a swarm of phantoms will emerge, each claiming to be the true Fischl von Luftschloss Narfidort, Sovereign of the Immernachtreich, and ruler of the Ashen Darkness...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: And then they'll immediately start arguing with each other in their completely incomprehensible language... eek.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Forget that, I shouldn't scare myself...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: The melody from my mirage is still playing in my head. That was such an incredible experience!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I was able to make my wish come true, but I'm not sure if everyone else will have as good an experience as I did...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Let's get some rest so we'll have enough energy! Whatever happens, I should do everything I can to help my friends.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I didn't bring it up at the time since I didn't want to cause anyone any more distress... still, the disappearance of the Fatui worries me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: From the look on your face... I see, it appears we have similar thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Then let's stay diligent, and keep an eye out for any further developments.

dialogues.speaker: Blazing Heart
dialogues.text: The spirit of resistance!

dialogues.speaker: Blazing Heart
dialogues.text: It feels good to shout out your motto at the top of your voice.

dialogues.speaker: Frozen Soul
dialogues.text: Shh... calm your mind and listen carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Frozen Soul
dialogues.text: Can you hear it? The ocean, the sky, and the mountains... everything in the world has its own unique song.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Okay, this ought to do the trick.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There is a sound coming from the island.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Kazuha, can you feel the wind? Which direction is it blowing in?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's coming from that direction. I'll take you to a hill where the wind blows.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Where did they come from!?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Anyway, Oz... um... I, uh, ahem... thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein, I was merely doing my duty. You need not thank me. Rather, it's my honor to follow you.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Then I shall grant you the honor of accompanying me to the performance.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: As you wish, mein Fräulein.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Fischl's dilemma was indeed within herself. But there was only one phantom, not a swarm... so my guess was a little off the mark.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: After all that she went through, it's good that she finally got to reconcile with herself.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Still, it looks like I won't be free from this Court Archmage role anytime soon...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Fischl's rebuttal totally rocked! It was so dramatic and so powerful! I didn't want to interrupt her, or I would've started blasting out a backing track!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: The stage is set up and everyone's here together. Love this feeling!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Let's celebrate this special occasion together!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: "On the homeward road, ravens soar into the sky..."

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Although the mirages are essentially independent, I believe there is some connection.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The final line... but of course, "Rainbow greets my eye."

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: "...spoke amid a downpour of the dragon's blood. She said, 'May my people be freed from the shackles of ancient decrees.'"

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Such wise and compassionate words could only come from your own writing, mein Fräulein.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hmph, yet this kingdom appears to be anything but what I've described. The shadows lurking behind the scenes are disconcerting...

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: "Prinzessin Fischl again continued her song, and the interwoven chords of her sacred words became the Immernachtreich's hymn."

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: "She picked up mere stones to carve out mountains and oceans, before bestowing upon her people castles and towns."

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: "My magnificent kingdom is a small and forbidden paradise."

dialogues.speaker: Leon
dialogues.text: Aah! Help me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's the book! Let's go and close it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's hope we won't get transported to another strange place this time...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hehe, greetings, my most loyal attendant.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Why, certainly. I bestow upon thee permission to ask any questions.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Oh? You have witnessed the theater of the Holy Land?

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Alright, out with it, be liberal with your words of praise. It is a singular achievement in all the world.

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Mein Fräulein eagerly anticipates your comments.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: It is the sacred scripture of the Immernachtreich. It must never be allowed to fall into disrepair from a lack of upkeep...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll take good care of it.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Hmph, you'd better.

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: In mein Fräulein's mind, it is a treasured memento of this journey. She is positively thrilled to know that you also see it as such.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Oz, do not over-interpret my speech!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: One was most delighted to behold the grand ceremony and celebration with which one's official excursion to this blessed land was received.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Alas, my journey through countless worlds has taught me that even the most splendid of things must come to an end.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: This is why I have declared to my people that my excursion goes on, as there are still attendants from faraway lands who require the Prinzessin's royal assistance.

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Mein Fräulein cried when she bade farewell to everyone.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Oz! I told you, that was only because an insolent grain of sand rudely took refuge in my eyes!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: O, thou whose fate doth intersect with mine own, please enjoy thyself fully in this paradise.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Is this the end of our vacation...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Sure, is there something you wanted to ask me?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: *sigh* It's really quite frustrating. Lately, my scryglass has been acting up whenever something major occurs.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: ...It's as if it's deliberately trying to stop me from seeing how things will end.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hold on... I hope you didn't bring that up just to poke fun at me?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Oh, I actually wanted to ask you as well. How did you feel when you saw that stretch of sky?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It was magnificent!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Oh... oh really?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Well, I—I am a genius astrologist, after all. Of course my mirage was going to be magnificent...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's the Mona I know!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hmm... But I was so immersed in my thoughts at the time, I didn't realize how magnificent until I heard you speak...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It was so spellbinding!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Yes, I know... It was on purpose, wasn't it?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Although I'm only here because Fischl dragged me along, somewhere on the way, this turned into a wonderful summer.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: To bear witness and to defend everyone's destiny... that's exactly what I try to do.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've done a great job.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Thank you. You too, of course... you've done a lot here.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I look forward to working with you again, hehe... I'm sure we will be even better partners.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Mmm, make sure to enjoy yourself before leaving this island.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I've got some new inspiration for a song...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Sure, I'd love to.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I am going to share this adventure with my friends when I get back. Who knows, it may even give Yun Jin some new ideas for her opera.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: As for Xiangling, I'm sure she'll come up with a bunch of suggestions the minute that anything cooking-related comes up.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: You know her, a true professional, she knows everything... Like how to make a good stew without a pot. That's something I'd like to learn from her...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I need to learn some new dishes before my new friends come to visit. Oh, and Roasted Lavender Melons is definitely gonna be one of them!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Are you a little disappointed that I didn't play any rock music back in my mirage?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Not at all.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Whew, glad to hear it.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Rock 'n' roll is my first love, that'll never change.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: But music is also a vehicle for all kinds of emotions. Rather than only expressing my own feelings, I figured what I did was more suitable for the occasion.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Hehe, perhaps now, I can call you a kindred spirit in our understanding of music.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: It's been action-packed and awesome fun!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I really have to thank you and that bard fella for the invitation.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I wonder how his live performances have been going... I owe him big time. I'll have to find a way to thank that guy in the future.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's buy him a drink.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Sure! It's a deal!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Okay, make sure to take it easy.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The sound of nature is so relaxing. There's nothing more to worry about...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Sure. What's on your mind?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Ahem...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: That was days ago. I'm surprised you still remember...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Fine drinks belong in the same space as poetry and elegance. To lose myself like that in the tavern... it was truly humiliating.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Right, about that. After these events, I suppose I've bid a formal farewell to my past.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Don't worry, I feel just as fine as I did during the times before. I am burdened by neither grief nor regret.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I appreciate these twists of fate from the bottom of my heart.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're always so chill...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Thank you. Can I take it as a compliment?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Certainly.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I'm so happy to have a friend like you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Let's shift our focus back to the scenery in front of us and take a good look at the clouds and waves before we leave.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It's had its ups and downs, but ultimately, it's been quite rewarding.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: If Beidou and the crew ask me about our experiences, I suppose I'll tell them about the squirrel and the ship spirit... as for stories about my new friends, I'll keep them to myself.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's good.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: #The end of every journey marks the beginning of a new adventure. I'm sure this is a feeling you are most familiar with, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: ...Keep moving forwards. That's the important thing.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Just like you, I have a lot of hope for the future.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: You must be tired from the past few days. Take a well-deserved rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've found all the crystalline cores. Let's put them back into the machine!
